lines.en: Flap wings high to the sky
Short legs are slow, but I do not stop.
I flap along the ground as I go.
My tail feathers flick up as I turn.

lines.zh: 圆滚滚的身子挤过灌木。
lines.en: My round body squeezes through the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我追着一只虫子跑了几步。
lines.en: I chase a bug a few steps.

lines.zh: 翅膀太短，只能滑一小段。
lines.en: My wings are too short; I glide only a little.

lines.zh: 我在沙滩上留下一串脚印。
lines.en: I leave a line of prints on the sand.
I walk with my head down, as if searching.
Close eyes to rest, feathers neat
I squat by the nest with my wings tucked.
Two soft coos, meaning nothing at all.
I can't fly, but I can watch.
Gaze at the player to attack
Watch the player to avoid detection
Watch the player to find weaknesses
Stare at the player to strike
Watch the player to avoid attack
Gaze at the player for an opportunity

lines.zh: 这几根短翅，本来就飞不动！
lines.en: These stubby wings couldn't fly anyway!

lines.zh: 我的脚踝一崴，只能蹦着走。
lines.en: My ankle twists; I can only hop.

lines.zh: 肚皮被划开，我蹲进草丛。
lines.en: My belly is cut; I squat down in the grass.

lines.zh: 我的短翅折了，本来也飞不起。
lines.en: My stub wing breaks. It never flew anyway.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛闪着绿色光芒，引诱着我靠近。
lines.en: Its green feathers tempt me closer.

lines.zh: 它的声音像钟声般悠扬，让我忍不住想要跟随。
lines.en: Its bell-like call tempts me to follow.

lines.zh: 看着它悠闲地飞翔，我不禁被它的优雅吸引。
lines.en: Its graceful flight tempts me to watch.

lines.zh: 它停在树枝上，我被它的眼睛所吸引。
lines.en: It perches on a branch, tempting me with its eyes.

lines.zh: 它发出咕咕声，仿佛在邀请我一起飞行。
lines.en: It coos, tempting me to join its flight.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛在阳光下闪耀，让我无法抗拒。
lines.en: Its feathers gleam in the sun, tempting me.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了诱惑，让我忍不住想要靠近。
lines.en: Its alluring gaze tempts me close.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同风铃，让人无法抵抗亲近它。
lines.en: Its bell-like call tempts me to approach.

lines.zh: 它优雅地降落，我被它的身姿所吸引。
lines.en: It lands gracefully, tempting me with its form.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛就像宝石，让我感到心驰神往。
lines.en: Its feathers are like jewels, tempting me with their brilliance.

lines.zh: 我撞上了它，被它的体型吓了一跳。
lines.en: I collide with it, startled by its size.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在我身边挥动，差点撞上我。
lines.en: Its wings swoop close, nearly brushing me.

lines.zh: 它飞得太低了，我差点被它的翅膀扫到。
lines.en: It flies so low, nearly brushing me with its wings.

lines.zh: 我躲避它的撞击，但它总是能碰到我。
lines.en: I try to dodge, but it always touches me.

lines.zh: 它的体型庞大，撞上我时几乎让我失去平衡。
lines.en: Its large size nearly unbalances me on impact.

lines.zh: 我试图靠近它，但它飞得太快，差点撞上我。
lines.en: I try to get close, but it flies too fast, nearly colliding with me.

lines.zh: 它拍打着翅膀，几乎撞上了我的头盔。
lines.en: It flaps its wings, nearly brushing my helmet.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀太重了，几乎撞倒了我。
lines.en: Its heavy wings nearly knock me over.

lines.zh: 它飞行得太快，我差点被它的气流吹倒。
lines.en: It flies so fast, nearly knocking me down with its airflow.

lines.zh: 我试图抓住它，但它飞行太快，差点撞上我。
lines.en: I try to catch it, but it flies too fast, nearly colliding with me.

lines.zh: 它寻找配偶时发出低沉的咕咕声。
lines.en: It makes a low coo to find a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声像心跳般稳定，吸引着伴侣。
lines.en: Its call is steady, like a heartbeat, attracting a mate.

lines.zh: 它寻找配偶，发出温柔的咕咕声。
lines.en: It seeks a mate, cooing softly.

lines.zh: 它发出咕咕声，寻找飞行中的伴侣。
lines.en: It coos, searching for a mate in flight.

lines.zh: 它的咕咕声在空中回荡，寻找配偶。
lines.en: Its coo echoes through the air, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它低沉的咕咕声，吸引着飞行中的伴侣。
lines.en: Its low coo draws a mate from the sky.

lines.zh: 它发出咕咕声，寻找合适的飞行伴侣。
lines.en: It coos, seeking a suitable flying mate.

lines.zh: 它的声音像远处的钟声，寻找飞行中的配偶。
lines.en: Its voice, like a distant bell, calls for a mate in flight.

lines.zh: 它的声音像低吟般温柔，寻找飞行中的伴侣。
lines.en: Its voice, like a soft moan, calls for a mate in flight.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的羽毛抖给它看。
lines.en: I shake my brightest feathers for my mate.
This egg's light, hold it well!
See if there's anything in it!

lines.zh: 别小看这蛋，孵化大惊喜！

lines.en: Be careful! Egg might be dangerous!

lines.zh: 孵化出的小渡渡鸟，多么可爱！
我摇摆着跑过去，羽毛掉了一路。
lines.en: I waddle over, shedding feathers the whole way.
I have feathers, you get hit!
Out of the egg, I come!

lines.zh: 蛋壳破裂，我是新渡渡鸟！
lines.en: Shell breaks, I'm a new dodo!
The egg in the sand pit rolls once.

lines.zh: 我从灌木下钻出来，抖了抖毛。
lines.en: I come out from under the bush and ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 一只刚破壳的小渡渡鸟。

lines.en: My feathers burn with a strange smell.

lines.zh: 我不会游水，羽毛全湿了。
lines.en: I cannot swim, and my feathers are soaked.
The blast sends my feathers everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的胸羽，我跑不动了。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my breast feathers; I can't run.

lines.zh: 那道光打过来，我的羽毛立起。
lines.en: That light strikes and my feathers stand up.
Hungry; I will go find some fruit.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛全立起来，像被烤过。
lines.en: My feathers stand up as if singed.
